entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: All right, there's Anji Fuwa! Let's[n]change his heart, for his family's sake.

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: Lily-nyan is kind... Lily-nyan is warm...

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: All I need is Lily-nyan...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Come on, man. You know that's not right,[n]don't you!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: O-Of course it's right! Spending money on[n]her makes me happy!

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: I'd do anything for her! Lily-nyan's smile is[n]what I live for!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: He's in no condition to listen. Watch out,[n]Joker!

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: Me and my wife were always arguing about[n]how to raise our kid... That's when I found[n]Lily-nyan.

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: Lily-nyan was always working hard and[n]smiling. I felt like I was chasing that dream[n]with her...

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: I was using Lily-nyan to escape my stressful[n]home life because she allowed me to dream[n]again...

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: Having a student point that out to me[n]drove me nuts. I'm so pathetic...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But now you know what you've gotta do,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: Indeed.

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: As long as I deal with my family first...[n]then I can chase after Lily-nyan!
I hope you can do both.
Become a man worthy of her.

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: Hell yeah!

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: This has truly been a learning experience[n]for me...!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So you're not gonna stop chasing her...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, guess it's not a bad thing to have a[n]hobby.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Become a dad your kid can be proud of.

entries.speaker: Shadow Fuwa
entries.en: If it's not too late, I will...!
